items.title: Actual PBPS: why the reflected augmented transition preserves its target

source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang. ASTIS expands normalization, explicit conditional-version identification and the retained-coordinate Tonelli argument. No author endorsement or complete-paper claim.
source.anchor: Proposition3.4, equation3.11 and Algorithm2; standing1.1/scale2.2; reflectionProp2.1iii and conditional reversibilityProp3.2

items.statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Suppose \(V\in C^2\), \(0<\alpha\le\beta\), \(\alpha\|v\|^2\le D^2V(x)[v,v]\le\beta\|v\|^2\) for all \(x,v\), \(\eta>0\), \(\beta\eta\le1\), and a fixed scalar \(0<\rho<1\). Let \(\mu(dx)\propto e^{-V(x)}dx\) and let \(J\) be the law of \((X,X+\sqrt\eta G)\) for independent \(X\sim\mu\), \(G\sim\mathcal N(0,I)\). Let \(q_y(dx)\propto e^{-V(x)-\|x-y\|^2/(2\eta)}dx\) and let \(H_y(x,\cdot)\) be the actual time-pi returned-position kernel, with an independent reference from \(q_y\), Gaussian momentum and iid unit exponential clocks. Reflect \(y\) to \(y\prime=2x-y\), draw the next position from \(\rho q_{y\prime}+(1-\rho)H_{y\prime}(x,\cdot)\), and retain \(y\prime\). This defines a Markov kernel \(K\) preserving \(J\). All probability normalizations and the conditional-kernel certificate are conclusions. The same literal clock recursion, covered-arc/fallback laws, parameterwise AE coverage/initialization, and actual H witness are retained in the folded full statement.
assumptions: The six standing analytic binders are unchanged: genuine C2/Hessian bounds, positive alpha and eta, alpha<=beta and beta eta<=1. The only new source binders are the fixed scalar rho and 0<rho<1; weights do not depend on state.

The potential, Gaussian, canonical volume and Hilbert-space assumptions match the actual half-turn producer. fderiv is totalized in Lean, but C2 supplies genuine differentiability; no derivative-zero fallback is used to infer regularity.

Gibbs integrability/positive normalizer, probability, explicit everywhere-defined q_y, joint measurable kernels, conditional disintegration, mixture mass one and invariant measures are internally derived, not supplied premises.

Conditional R is the explicit normalized quadratic tilt at EVERY y. Its equality to the retained R follows from their explicit fiber laws, not from almost-everywhere uniqueness of arbitrary conditional versions.
All old path coverage/initialization null sets remain parameterwise. This one-step law does not assert a temporal Markov/restart/semigroup property or any convergence rate.

assumption_deltas.source: Euclidean state and standing analytic and fixed resampling regimes.
assumption_deltas.lean: Finite real Hilbert Borel E, including rank zero; same six analytic inputs and rho in (0,1).
assumption_deltas.reason: The existing coordinate-free actual-process and Gaussian producers apply with no extra analytic binder.

assumption_deltas.source: Conditional preservation implies joint preservation, then composition with Gaussian reflection.
assumption_deltas.lean: Explicit R equals the literal q at every center and disintegrates J.swap. Measurable sections and nonnegative Tonelli lift fiber invariance; fixed weights and coordinate transport then give the literal eq3.11 law.
assumption_deltas.reason: Null-fiber version choices and all measurable product-kernel obligations are proved internally.
